resources.string: A Scribe button above your usual keyboard

Shows a small Scribe button just above your usual keyboard (SwiftKey, for example). Tap it to talk straight into the box, or hold it to switch to the Scribe keyboard. Scribe checks whether a keyboard is open, whose it is, and whether the box is a password box, where the button hides. It reads the words around the cursor only when you tap it to type in or fix something, and does not keep anything you type.
